2608.19794.title: Towards general embodied intelligence: integrating large language models, knowledge bases, and reasoning capabilities to build the next generation of AI agents
2608.19794.paper_summary: The convergence of large language models (LLMs), structured knowledge bases (KBs), and reasoning ability (RA) presents a promising trajectory toward general embodied intelligence (GEI). This paper reviews the evolution of LLM-centered intelligent systems, emphasising their integration with knowledge representation, logical reasoning, and physical embodiment. We analyse LLM architectures, pre-training methods, and inference mechanisms, along with their interaction with external knowledge sources and structured reasoning frameworks. Furthermore, we examine embodied intelligence (EI) paradigms wherein agents learn and act in physical environments. To synthesise these dimensions, we present a conceptual framework that illustrates the synergy among LLMs, KBs, RA, and embodiment, serving as a guiding model for perception, reasoning, and action rather than an implemented engineering architecture. To advance toward GEI, we identify five key challenges: efficient LLM deployment, closed-loop knowledge integration, hybrid symbolic-neural reasoning, perception-action grounding, and continual learning. This survey provides a comprehensive roadmap for developing adaptive, multimodal agents capable of operating in complex, dynamic settings.
2608.19794.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）、結構化知識庫（KBs）和推理能力（RA）的融合展現了通往一般具身智慧（GEI）的有希望的發展路徑。本文回顧了以LLM為中心的智能系統的演變，強調它們與知識表示、邏輯推理和物理具身的整合。我們分析了LLM架構、預訓練方法和推理機制，以及它們與外部知識來源和結構化推理框架的互動。此外，我們檢視了具身智慧（EI）範式，其中代理在物理環境中學習和行動。為了綜合這些維度，我們提出了一個概念框架，說明LLMs、KBs、RA和具身之間的協同作用，作為感知、推理和行動的指導模型，而非實施的工程架構。為了向GEI邁進，我們確定了五個關鍵挑戰：高效的LLM部署、閉環知識整合、混合符號-神經推理、感知-行動基礎和持續學習。本調查提供了一個全面的路線圖，以發展能夠在複雜動態環境中運作的自適應多模態代理。
